content: The OGN gene encodes a protein known as osteoglycin, which is also referred to as mimecan. This protein plays a role in inducing ectopic bone formation when it interacts with transforming growth factor beta (TGF-β). Osteoglycin is classified as a small proteoglycan and is characterized by the presence of tandem leucine-rich repeats (LRR) within its structure. The OGN gene produces three distinct transcript variants. Elevated expression levels of this gene have been associated with cardiac enlargement, particularly left ventricular hypertrophy.
